title: DDGS 2.1.0
release_notes:
- Smarter Assistant that finishes the job and shows its thinking again, with a clear receipt on every answer
- Every page question starts its own chat; replies keep streaming while you start another
- Format switches keep the summary without a fresh charge; proxy now covers everything
- Undo on every delete, Load more results, pinch-zoom images with share and copy link
- Fixed: the app starts reliably on Android; alerts always dismiss; unsafe links stay blocked
